estilo-redaccion.title: Writing style
estilo-redaccion.hint: Tone, structure, words you use and avoid. Used by CVs and letters.

perfil-conductual.title: Behavioral profile
perfil-conductual.hint: How you work, strengths, personality tests. For preparing interviews.

criterios.title: Criteria
criterios.hint: Deal-breakers (what you would never accept, such as on-call duty or weekly travel) and preferences in free text. The fit assessment cites them as risks.

narrativa.title: Narrative
narrativa.hint: Your story, motivation and how you explain changes. For interviews.

folders.candidaturas: What you sent in each application (fills up on its own)
folders.estilo: Samples of how you write (letters, emails, posts): the agent takes your tone from them, never facts.

fileLabel.linkedin: Your LinkedIn export (the compressed file LinkedIn sends you, or your profile as PDF)

import.title: Import information from a CV
import.intro: Upload a CV (PDF or Word) and your agent adds to your profile what it is missing, such as experience or achievements. It shows you the differences before saving.
import.stepAgent: Your agent reads it and compares it with your profile

title: My profile
intro: Everything a CV, letter or answer says comes from here. Each block is saved separately and can be undone.

docs.lead: How you want your CVs and letters, and what your agent reads to write them. Nothing here counts as a fact: facts come from your profile.
docs.prefsTitle: How you want your CVs and letters
docs.notesLead: They guide the tone, interviews and the risks of a job.
docs.notesHint: They never back a fact: anything a CV or letter says has to be in your profile. Each note comes with a few guiding questions; you can also ask your agent to write it.
docs.filesLead: What your agent can read to create or extend your profile.
docs.filesHint: Your source documents. Your agent reads them and always asks you before writing to your profile.
docs.unsavedOpen: It has unsaved changes: save or discard them to collapse it.

letter.none: No preferences: your agent uses the app’s

short.estilo-redaccion: Tone, structure, words you use and avoid
short.perfil-conductual: How you work and your strengths, for interviews
short.criterios: What you would not accept and your preferences
short.narrativa: Your story and how you explain your moves
short.samples: Letters, emails or posts of yours, to pick up your tone
